Sets single cells of a raster to new values, given by their column and row or by their coordinates.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Correct, Edit, Cells<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterCorrector`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to correct. |
| `pCorrections` | String |  |  | The corrections, as a comma separated list of triplets: col1,row1,value1,col2,row2,value2... or, with the coordinates, east1,north1,value1... |
| `doCoordinates` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, the triplets have the coordinates of the cells instead of their column and row. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The corrected raster. |
